audit_limitations: This audit is provisional LLM analysis based solely on the provided synthetic wearable data and arithmetic statistics. No clinical conclusions can be drawn. The representations were evaluated against numerical observations without access to ground-truth labels or human expert review. PROVISIONAL_LLM_GOLD relevance labels are fallible and do not constitute factual proof. Small mean differences (e.g., 1.14 minutes of sleep, 14.75 steps) may not be practically meaningful despite being arithmetically precise. Correlation coefficients are based on small samples (13-28 pairs) and should not be over-interpreted. Activity intensity is uniformly unknown, limiting any temporal analysis involving exercise recommendations. Low-movement minutes lack posture context, preventing classification as sedentary behavior. This audit cannot establish causal relationships or validate health claims.
